title: pericallis lanata
intro: Pericallis lanata, commonly known as the woolly pericallis, is a flowering plant species native to the Canary Islands and the Azores. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, and is believed to aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions attributed to Pericallis lanata include sedative and anxiolytic effects, as well as the ability to alleviate symptoms of insomnia and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Pericallis lanata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
